description: This file implements an I2S bus (SSC) driver for Atmel SAM microcontroller family within Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, DMA handling, interrupt service routines, and device initialization.

methods.name: queue_get
methods.description: Retrieves a data block from the ring buffer queue.

methods.name: queue_put
methods.description: Adds a data block to the ring buffer queue.

methods.name: reload_dma
methods.description: Reloads and starts a DMA transfer.

methods.name: start_dma
methods.description: Configures and initiates a DMA transfer.

methods.name: dma_rx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for receive operations, handles received data and prepares next transfer.

methods.name: dma_tx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for transmit operations, handles sent data and loads next transfer.

methods.name: rx_queue_drop
methods.description: Clears RX queue and frees associated memory.

methods.name: tx_queue_drop
methods.description: Clears TX queue and frees associated memory.

methods.name: i2s_sam_configure
methods.description: Configures the I2S interface with specified settings, including data format and clock.

methods.name: i2s_sam_config_get
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration for RX or TX.

methods.name: i2s_sam_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine handling I2S-related interrupts.

methods.name: i2s_sam_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the I2S device, sets up clocks, pins, and interrupts.
